invariants.text: Employee.employee_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
Employee.department_id must reference an existing Department.department_id
Department.department_id must be an auto-incremented integer primary key with default value None
An employee must belong to a department.
Each department must have at least one employee.
The department_id of an employee must reference a valid department_id in the Department table.
